name: Flaunt Beauty Lounge
headline: Beauty That Brings Out Your Best.
lede: Ladies beauty salon in Bur Dubai with lounges in Al Mankhool and Al Raffa. Hair, facials, nails, waxing, bridal makeup and henna. Book on WhatsApp.
about: Flaunt Beauty Lounge brings together hair care, facial treatments, nail services, makeup and personal grooming under one roof as a premier professional beauty salon in Dubai. Our trained team helps you find the right treatments for your needs, whether you are preparing for a special occasion or simply taking time for yourself. Visit us at our two beauty lounge in Dubai locations, Al Mankhool and Al Raffa.

From everyday styling to wedding celebrations, Flaunt Beauty Lounge offers services for different beauty and grooming needs. Our specialisation in bridal makeup and hairstyling makes us a choice worth considering when preparing for your big day.
